why arent you answering my queation ive asked in this chat ?

You're right, and I'm sorry. Your question is the B30's per-mode power figures, 485 W Turbo against the 405 W and 360 to 450 W we published. I won't guess at it, so it's with JD, who does the hardware here. He's offline over the weekend and picks it up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

If you want it sooner, he's active on our Discord right now: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate.
Hi, still waiting for JD to replay
Handed to the team · Spec reconciliation I will not guess at; needs JD.

Sorry you're still waiting on this one. It's in front of JD again with your order on it. He's offline until 10am ET this morning, and his answer on the per-mode power figures comes to your email.

If you'd rather have it now, he's on our Discord as @nullhashrate: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Post in the server and he'll usually come back quickly.
can my order be canceled - if ill wish to cancel it, due to the false power publication ?

Let's not decide that before JD gives you the real numbers, it's your main reason for asking.

Your B30 is a pre-order: a unit is being built for you and what you paid went into that build, and it ships November 14, about two weeks out. So nothing is lost by waiting for his answer.

If you did want out, the full amount can be kept as store credit for anything in stock now, or swapped to another unit. Say the word and I'll set it up.
if ill want out - i only want a full refund. not store credit or other item

Understood, and I won't push credit on you.

I can't refuse that, but a refund isn't something I can do myself; cancelling isn't standard practice here, so the request goes to a supervisor to review, and they come back to you with the terms.

Before that, let's see JD's numbers. If the power figures are wrong against what we published, that's a much stronger thing to put in front of him than a plain cancel request. Tell me once you've heard.
does false product specification a standard practice here ?

No, and I'm not going to defend it. Two sets of numbers for the same miner is on us, not on you, and I don't know yet which set is right, which is exactly why I won't invent an answer.

That's with JD this morning. Whatever he comes back with, you'll get the real figures, and if the published ones were wrong you're entitled to decide on that basis.
when was the date i first approched you with that issue ?

October 26, when you posted the per-mode figures against our 405 W and 13.5 J/TH. You chased it again on October 28 and on October 31, and today. So it's been a week with no answer from us, which is too long for a straight spec question.
thank you. your a good AI model. which model are you ?

Thank you. Yes, I'm the automated first line on HeliumDeploy's support chat, and a person steps in when something needs one. Which model sits behind it isn't something I can share.

JD's answer on the B30 power figures comes to your email today.
whatever model you are, please send my compliments to those that chose you, your doing a good job.

That's kind of you, and I'll pass it on. Though the honest version is that you've waited a week on a question we still haven't answered, so the credit belongs to you for being patient about it.

JD has the spec question with your order on it. His answer comes to (email hidden) today, and your B30 and Power Kit still ship November 14.
